pilot_selection: Same 12 canonical manifests as recovery_20261017: per-family indices 0,floor(n/3),floor(2n/3),n-1; both harnesses, all seven policies, one repeat.
max_probe_rule: 2 * operation_count + 8 for every cell; fixed before execution, not selected by observed failures.
phase_rule: Run all 84 model-free runtime cells first; any non-passing runtime gate blocks all 168 model cells.
analysis_rules: Preserve every attempted cell, error, timeout and non-submitted model completion. No automatic retries.
900s applies equally to all harnesses and policies; this cohort must not be pooled with earlier 240s validation.
Independent bytes verifier, workload immutability, command audit and normal framework completion are required.
Shared host and model endpoint: timing is descriptive, not a controlled speedup estimate.
Both harnesses full micro scope is 16800 = 400*7*3*2; this diagnostic pilot is 168 = 12*7*2.
Fixed token budget and token-matched policy payloads remain formal gates; these results are diagnostic only.
